finding_dispositions.reason: Accepted ledger finding AUTH41/ADV41-F-001 is confirmed by verifier verify41-confirmed; CP-12's exhaustive allowed_edges cell omits every charged failure edge into CHARGED_ACCOUNTING_BLOCKED at design-v38 lines 143-148, 221, 372, so a legitimately charged accounting failure has no registered owner transition.

Confirmed at design-v38 lines 214 and 348-356: CP-05 admits FROZEN to MIGRATION_MAINTENANCE without naming accepted ADMIN_LEDGER_GENESIS and its receipt as preconditions, contradicting the stated genesis-before-migration prerequisite.

Confirmed at design-v38 lines 303, 332, 386 and 513: no predicate equates the registry's selected design_raw_sha256 with the design hash covered by the council ReviewClosureReceipt, so re-hashing proves only individual validity, not that the accepted design is the council-passed revision.

Confirmed at design-v38 lines 113-124 and 211-213: CP-02 and CP-04 declare HUMAN recovery edges without their destinations, so restore/complete and remain-blocked outcomes cannot be deterministically distinguished by P3/P15 or fixtures.

Confirmed at design-v38 lines 8, 624 and 672-680: the Section 15.1 exact-basis list never raw-byte binds the run-040 authority and run-040 adversarial envelopes whose finding IDs rows 672-680 claim to close, so those closure rows are not independently reproducible.

Confirmed at design-v38 lines 202 and 221-224 and 540-574: the Section 14 coverage index omits the CP-12 charged-accounting success edge, the CP-14 REVIEW_PENDING-to-REVIEWING return, and the CP-15 return edges while Section 5.0.1 requires coverage of every allowed_edges value.

Confirmed at design-v38 lines 224-225: CP-16 declares itself the sole owner row for the terminal completion-chain head yet does not register ACCEPTED-to-ACCEPTANCE_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT while CP-15 lists it, violating the one-owner-per-edge rule.

Confirmed at design-v38 lines 206, 281 and 386: TransitionCapabilityManifest.design_sha256 is never required to equal the resolved AcceptedDesignRegistry generation or AdmissionBundle.design_basis hash at P5/P14/P15, so a manifest authored for an earlier revision can be admitted as READY.

Confirmed at sanitized-design-v38 line 319: the closed freshness_rule compares a monotonic-clock reading against the wall-clock expires_at_utc field, leaving the comparison without a single defined clock domain and making freshness validation non-deterministic.

Confirmed at sanitized-design-v38 line 538: the Section 14 normative coverage statement maps failures only to CP-03 through CP-16, leaving the CP-01/CP-02 genesis states without a failure-matrix anchor despite genesis-failure scenarios elsewhere.

Confirmed at sanitized-design-v38 lines 667 and 671: prior finding ID EXT39R-O-006 appears in two rows with different v38 correction locators and fixtures, so the required finding-ID completeness diff can double-count or leave the closing correction ambiguous.

Confirmed at sanitized-design-v38 line 451: Section 9.2 step 2 makes migration consume an execution-representation decision that P15 and Section 6.1 item (g) produce inside bootstrap while CP-03 requires an accepted migrated base first, creating the circular dependency the design claims to avoid.

Confirmed at sanitized-design-v38 line 231: a differing or partial pre-charge NOT_APPLIED completion is owned by NOT_READY in Section 5.1(e) and by UNCHARGED_COMPLETION_CORRUPT_BLOCKED in Section 9.1/CP-11, giving one observed condition two owning states and no precedence rule.

Confirmed at sanitized-design-v38 line 624: Section 15.1 pins its basis artifacts by SHA-256 only with no canonical path, so the required audit re-hash, stale-revision scan and finding-completeness diff cannot be reproduced from the design bytes alone.

Confirmed at sanitized-design-v38 lines 222-223: edge REVIEWING-to-REVISION_REQUIRED_CHARGED is declared in both the CP-13 and CP-14 rows, so P3 allowlist and P15 fixture ownership for that edge are ambiguous.

Confirmed at sanitized-design-v38 line 649: the closure row for AUTH38-F-003 and AUTH38-F-004 names an explicit v36 locator contract, a stale-revision token the matrix's own stale-token scan would flag.

Confirmed at sanitized-design-v38 lines 330-336: Section 6.1 lists eleven bootstrap artifacts and operations required before WBS build while the AdmissionBundle is described as not a new runtime service, so the HUMAN-facing approval packet can underestimate pre-WBS control-plane scope.

Confirmed at sanitized-design-v38 line 368: Section 6.3 gives a worked integer fixture for the pre-charge reservation and root recurrence but none for the post-charge D/B recovery recurrence, leaving BA-02/BA-03/BA-04 exhaustion and UNKNOWN-usage checks without an in-design numeric anchor.

recommendation: Keep v38 frozen and correct it in a new design revision before any WBS build: register the CP-12 charged-accounting failure edges and the missing CP-02/CP-04 blocked-state destinations; make accepted genesis plus its receipt a CP-05 precondition and resolve the migration/bootstrap representation-decision circularity; add the review-receipt-to-selected-design hash equality and the TransitionCapabilityManifest design_sha256 equality to P5/P14/P15; add Section 14 coverage rows and single-owner attribution for the duplicated and unowned edges; define one clock domain for expires_at_utc; bind canonical path plus raw SHA-256 for every Section 15.1 basis artifact including the run-040 authority and adversarial envelopes; deduplicate the EXT39R-O-006 row, remove the stale v36 token, state the precedence between NOT_READY and UNCHARGED_COMPLETION_CORRUPT_BLOCKED, add the post-charge D/B worked fixture, and disclose the full pre-WBS bootstrap inventory and authority in the HUMAN approval packet; then rerun the affected lanes on the new revision.
residual_risks: Every lane ran with restriction_mode prompt-only and no persona or tool filter, so lane read-only isolation was prompt-declared rather than sandbox-enforced and cannot be independently proven from the records.

Ten outside-view observations were promoted and accepted without adjudication, and the outside lane received only the sanitized design with no Sources of Truth, so its scope judgements rest on the design bytes alone.
Adjudication was not triggered and no conflict gate was evaluated in a persisted adjudication record, so any latent high-severity disagreement between lanes remains unexamined.
The claim that the run-040 outside-view envelope is schema-invalid remains a process assertion recorded in the design header; it was not re-validated in this run and could have dropped a formal lane.

AcceptedDesignRegistry and AdmissionBundle binding gaps (ADV41-F-003, AUTH41-F-004) mean a future corrected revision could still admit a superseded design or manifest if the equality predicates are added without adversarial fixtures.
No executable validator, schema or fixture was run for this design-only review; all confirmation is read-based, so arithmetic and recurrence claims remain unexercised by execution.
